sections.heading: Which Medi-Cal program you land in
sections.intro: The coverage group you are in determines your income limit, whether assets are counted, and whether the 2027 work rule applies to you.

sections.heading: 2026 MAGI income limits (Medi-Cal for Adults, 138% FPL)
Assets: who is subject, who is not
sections.intro: California reinstated asset limits for non-MAGI programs on January 1, 2026. Adults in the MAGI New Adult Group are not subject to an asset test.

sections.heading: Cost sharing from October 1, 2028 (section 71120)
sections.intro: The same federal law that added the work requirement also changes cost sharing for expansion adults above 100% FPL, starting in 2028. It does not change your 2026 or 2027 costs, and it is a separate rule from the work requirement.
